_readme: S645, 2026-11-13. Diablo Valley's paid read (run 43353452924) listed 112 program pages for 267 programs: the program-index step read the six grid pages and 72 program areas (the grid holds 77: read 6, run 43344234543), and 115 programs had no page. They fall in whole areas (Dental, Early Childhood Education, Culinary Arts, Kinesiology, Music, Philosophy, Spanish, Japanese and Russian, Dance, Drama, ESL, Psychology, Sociology, English, History, Plumbing and Steamfitting). The capture filed no list of the areas it read. This read loads the six grid pages once each and prints every area address, to name the five the step's follow pattern (/academics/explore-our-programs/[a-z0-9-]+$) did not take and the slugs of the areas whose programs were not found. No model call.

questions.area_links: What address does each card on this grid page link, and does any area link a shape other than /academics/explore-our-programs/<slug> (a trailing slash, a query, another path, another host)?
